capture_method: All UI inputs and screenshots through cua_repl. Images unretouched. PNG and SVG exports through native Export panel with the two upper labels still selected.
results: First Auto label: enter 4 mm, Undo restores Auto, Redo restores 4 mm.
Second upper label: perpendicular 40-pixel drag retains attachment and shows 2.866 mm; numeric entry sets 4 mm.
Select both upper labels: shared 3 mm edit; one Undo restores both to 4 mm.
Angled upper label: Auto then Undo restores 2 mm; Detach removes gap controls, Undo restores attachment and 2 mm.
Drag angled arrow by 100x50 screen pixels: both attached labels follow; Undo restores original arrow and label positions.
Save As reaction-conditions.rsk, close document, reopen from disk: both upper labels retain 4 mm; undo history is empty.
SVG and PNG exported while selected guides visible: all six labels and three arrows present, no selection handles or magenta gap guides in exports. PNG visually inspected.

image_conditions.equal-gaps.png: 125% zoom after reopening reaction-conditions.rsk, Arial 10 pt, light theme, JACS/ACS, native screenshot 2560x1704
image_conditions.angled-gap.png: 130% zoom before Save As, same drawing content and theme, native screenshot 2560x1704
image_conditions.reaction-conditions.png: Native whole-drawing PNG export, default export scale/background

limitations: Sideways detachment, persistence edge cases, zero/reversed arrows, units, and invalid numeric input additionally covered by automated tests; not claimed as separate native interactions.
